name: glanceline
description: Your Claude Code session at a glance with zero extra rows: limits with pace, context, cache countdown and git on the hint line; a receipt on every turn's closing line; agents and compaction forecast in the footer; native heads-up notifications; a details pane and share card.

preset.title: Layout
preset.description: minimal, default or full (two lines with bars, cost and git)

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Nerd Font icons before each segment

toasts.title: Heads-up toasts
toasts.description: Toasts in the terminal: before the cache goes cold, when a limit is on pace to run out, repeated tool failures, compaction

notifications.title: Native notifications
notifications.description: Desktop notifications for the high-value heads-ups (cache about to go cold, a usage window reset) so they reach you in another app

receipt.title: Turn receipt
receipt.description: What each turn's closing line adds: short (cost, cache hit, tools), full (adds context, agents, output) or off
